items.title: Demo 2 - Custom Mezzanine Module (100 pts)
items.desc: Each team member completes the schematic, PCB design, and test firmware for a mezzanine module containing a subcircuit used in the final project. Must include a meaningful software/firmware part; purely hardware designs aren't allowed. Individual assignment; each member designs a different subcircuit. Power supply is handled in Demo 3.

items.title: Week 8
items.desc: Attend 1 ECE453 lab session this week; counts toward Quality and Effort (100% if you attended).

items.title: ID Bibliographic Sources (10 pts)
items.desc: Annotated bibliography: at least 4 citations with full bibliographic info relevant to your tradition. Use a variety of source types (not four online articles); at least two must be scholarly/peer-reviewed.

items.title: Schedule Consultant Interview (20 pts)
items.desc: Schedule an interview (block at least an hour) with your consultant and report it here; include it if already done. Make sure they know what you'll ask about and why.

items.title: Week 10
items.desc: Attend 1 ECE453 lab session this week; counts toward Quality and Effort (100% if you attended).

items.title: Essay 2 upload (100 pts)
items.desc: Upload opens Mon Oct 26 at 4:30pm.

items.title: CAD Tutorial 2
items.desc: Cadence Virtuoso tutorial (ECE555_tutorial_2_F26.pdf). Don't recreate your ece555 directory or rerun the setup script; each session run `module load courses/ece555/asap7-cadence-calibre` and export the VAR_M* offsets before launching. Not graded, but Homework 3 depends on it.

items.title: Knowledge Entries 15 and 16
items.desc: Daily Knowledge Journal. Respond to the day's readings before class and turn the journal in before or at the start of class. Upload a photo of the page.

items.title: Homework 3 (100 pts)
items.desc: Extensive layout design, start early. Uses CAD Tutorial 2. FO4 load can be done in the layout (four inverters on the AND output) or in the testbench. Submit a readable PDF.

items.title: Field Report (60 pts)
items.desc: Interview a veteran, reservist, or active-duty service member (your consultant) about a military tradition they know or practice. Must be a real ethnographic interview.

items.title: Project Milestone-1, gate-level design (25 pts)
items.desc: Gate-level design. Only the first milestone is due now; requirements in F26-Project-ECE555.pdf, details in F26_ECE555_project.pptx. Submit as PDF or Word.

items.title: Demo 3 - Team Integration (100 pts)
items.desc: Integrate the team's individual designs into one system and show how critical functional requirements are met. Also design a power mezzanine board; have staff review the schematic before layout.

items.title: Instructor Assigned Quality and Achievement (100 pts)
Zine: discuss style with instructor (10 pts)
items.desc: Brief in-class meeting about your zine: be ready to discuss style, tone, aesthetics, and materials.

items.title: Informal Presentation
items.desc: Short 5-10 minute presentation of your research to the class; can use your essay or a zine draft. Points count toward Participation.

items.title: Completed Project Files, Final Project Video, Individual Assessment #2
items.desc: Three final deliverables, all due the same night.

items.title: Essay (150 pts)
items.desc: Short essay on your research topic with contextual info, drawing on your research and your consultant interview. Describe the military folklore text/artifact with context (history, usage, meaning, development).

items.title: Zine (140 pts)
items.desc: Turn your research, interview, and essay into a zine. Follow the zine-making instructions and make at least three copies (one for the instructor, one to share).
